author: KEXP
description: On their latest album 'This Mirror Weighs A Ton,' the emblematic New York-based band Interpol experiment with new textures. In-studio with DJ John Richards, the indie rock heroes share a live set of songs from across their discography, including the 2007 track "See Out Loud."
title: Interpol performs "See Out Loud" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:

Paul Banks - Lead vocals, Guitar
